# StoryMaker AI

> AI-powered story creator that generates unique, customizable stories for children, teens, and adults with tailored characters, settings, and themes.

StoryMaker AI helps users craft personalized stories using AI. You can pick age groups, genres, characters, and themes, then export finished stories in multiple formats. A community section lets users browse and share stories.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Create custom AI-generated stories with configurable characters, themes, and settings.
- [Community Stories](/share-stories): Browse and share stories created by the community.
- [Chat Assistant](/chat-assistant): Interactive AI assistant to help brainstorm and refine stories.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Personalized overview with recent stories, usage stats, and writing goals.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/sign-in): Account sign in.
- [Sign up](/sign-up): Create a new account.
